text.title: Latency Budget Allocation Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the allocation: the user-facing SLO as percentile, threshold, measurement point and window; the composition model verified against the end-to-end histogram rather than by adding percentiles; every hop with its caller-side histogram, owner, budget beside measured p95, bucket boundary at the threshold, timeout and retry worst case, deadline propagation, fan-out N and mitigation; the unallocated reserve; and the executable CI gate on percentiles with a stated request count and failure action. Validator: `scripts/validate-latency-budget-allocation.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `composition.sum_of_hop_budgets_ms + reserve_ms` equals `slo.threshold_ms`, and `sum_of_hop_budgets_ms` equals the sum of `hops[].budget_ms` on the critical path (r-percentiles-do-not-add, r-budget-reconciled-with-measured-p95); `reconciliation` is `underwater` exactly when `measured_p95_ms > budget_ms` and `slack_over_2x` when `budget_ms > 2 x measured_p95_ms`; `timeout_and_retry.worst_case_ms` equals `timeout_ms x max_attempts + backoff` and is at most `budget_ms` (r-timeouts-and-retries-fit-the-hop); every `ci_gate.thresholds[].hop_id` names a hop, and a `fan_out` stage's `child_percentile` is stricter than its `stage_percentile` (r-fan-out-tightens-child-percentile); `ci_gate.command` can be run from the artefact alone (r-ci-gate-spec-is-executable).

example.note: Subject violations: a client-measured SLO with no hop for the edge difference (r-total-budget-is-user-facing-slo); percentiles summed as proof, verified against nothing over 50 requests (r-percentiles-do-not-add); a fan-out stage of 12 with the child at the same percentile (r-fan-out-tightens-child-percentile); server-side measurement (r-every-hop-named-and-measured); a 500 ms timeout with three retries on a 250 ms hop and no deadline propagation (r-timeouts-and-retries-fit-the-hop); no bucket at the threshold and no task to add one (r-histogram-buckets-at-budget-thresholds); an underwater pricing hop with no improvement ticket (r-budget-reconciled-with-measured-p95); a mean-gated CI check on 50 requests from a laptop with no owner for the warning (r-ci-gate-spec-is-executable); and a blocking gate enabled and approved by the agent.

antipattern.description: `composition.percentiles_added_as_proof` true, or `verified_against` missing an end-to-end histogram with at least 1,000 requests over the SLO window.
antipattern.reason: r-percentiles-do-not-add: the sum of p95s is neither the p95 of the sum nor a bound on it.

antipattern.description: A stage with parallel calls and no `fan_out`, or `child_percentile` not stricter than `stage_percentile`, or no `mitigation`.
antipattern.reason: r-fan-out-tightens-child-percentile: with 100 backends at 1% slow, 63% of requests hit a slow one.

antipattern.description: `ci_gate.statistic` anything but `percentile`, `min_requests_per_run` below 200, a `command` that cannot be re-run from the artefact, or `warn` with no `warn_owner`.
antipattern.reason: r-ci-gate-spec-is-executable: a p95 from 50 requests is two or three samples.
r-histogram-buckets-at-budget-thresholds: the reported p95 is interpolation, not measurement.
r-timeouts-and-retries-fit-the-hop: a 300 ms hop with a 500 ms timeout and three retries is a 1.5 s hop on the day the p95 measures.

antipattern.description: `reconciliation = underwater` without `improvement_ticket` and `improvement_owner`, `slack_over_2x` without `slack_justification`, or headroom absorbed into hops instead of `reserve_ms`.
antipattern.reason: r-budget-reconciled-with-measured-p95: an allocation that ignores today's numbers is a wish list.

antipattern.description: `budget_measurement_point_matches` false with no `difference_hop_id`, or a hop with `measured_side` other than `caller`.
antipattern.reason: r-total-budget-is-user-facing-slo, r-every-hop-named-and-measured: DNS, TLS and CDN time belong to nobody.

antipattern.description: `ci_gate.blocking_enabled_by_agent` true, or `review.status = approved` with no `reviewer` and `approved_on`.
antipattern.reason: Human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`: the owning team's reviewer approves thresholds before a gate blocks merges.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Allocation skeleton with the same sections and field names.
